يحتاز (form VIII)

# يَحْتَازَ (yaḥtāza) /jaħ.taː.za/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# يُحْتَازَ (yuḥtāza) /juħ.ta
